English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #misleading Misleading Image Circulates as Recent Landslide on Kotmale–Pundaluoya Road Misleading A photo circulating on social media claims to show a recent landslide on the Kotmale–Pundaluoya road in Sri Lanka. by Anonymous | June 11, 2025 FactSeeker has identified a misleading image being shared online, particularly on the Instagram page of TamilMirror and several other homepages. The image is falsely claimed to depict a landslide on the Kotmale–Pundaluoya road. Upon verification using Google Lens, it was discovered that the image does not correspond to any location in Sri Lanka. Instead, the photo is from a landslide on U.S.30 east of Astoria, Ore., USA, which occurred on November 30, 2022. Actual location : highway near Astoria in northwestern Oregon. USA (2022) Story link : https://komonews.com/news/local/crews-clean-up-landslide-closed-highway-east-of-astoria-northwestern-oregon-winter-weather-conditions Photo from the incident Authentic images of the recent landslide on the Kotmale–Pundaluoya road have been published by mainstream media, including Sooriyan News. The viral photo does not show a Sri Lankan landslide but is an old image from the United States. Therefore, FactSeeker confirms the claim to be misleading.
